# Creation of the Animals (Genesis 1:25)

## Emotional Focus
Thankfulness for all the animals God made.

## Key KJV
“And God made the beast of the earth after his kind, and cattle after their kind, and every thing that creepeth upon the earth after his kind: and God saw that it was good.” (Genesis 1:25)

## Gentle Retelling
On the sixth day God made all the animals—big and small, furry and feathery. He looked at them and said they were good. Every pet and every wild creature shows us how creative God is.

## Coloring Prompt
Happy mix of gentle animals (lion, lamb, birds, fish) playing together peacefully.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“Thank You, God, for making all the animals and for making me.”
